body:
WHAT
The hint line under the composer shows the current context size ('ctx ~12.3k') and the liveness strip shows this turn's output tokens; both figures come from the engine (context_update, turn_finished). The renderer never adds output to context, never sums contexts across turns, and shows no percentage. When several consoles are tiled the top-bar meter sums the current context of each tab.

WHY
Adding output to input or accumulating over turns would show a context figure that grows past the real window and misleads users about compaction.

WHERE
app/renderer/modules/session.js — variables contextTokens, outputTokens, contextWarn; contextLabel(tokens); updateSessionMeter(); updateContextMeter() (sum over tabs, only when tiled); resetSessionMeter(). app/renderer/modules/tokens.js — formatTokens(n), estimateTokens(), CHARS_PER_TOKEN (mirror of engine/protocol/src/tokens.ts). app/renderer/modules/landing.js — case "context_update" (contextTokens = event.contextTokens ?? contextTokens; outputTokens only when a number is present), onTurnFinished (usage.outputTokens), onTurnStarted (outputTokens = 0). app/renderer/modules/views.js — renderNowTokens().

TEST CHECKLIST
1. A context_update with contextTokens 12345 sets the hint text to 'ctx ~12k' (formatTokens) and does not change outputTokens when the event has no outputTokens field.
2. After context_update { contextTokens: 10000, outputTokens: 500 } the hint shows 10k and the liveness strip shows 500 — never 10.5k anywhere.
3. Two successive turns each reporting contextTokens 8000 show 8k after the second, not 16k; turn_started resets outputTokens to 0 without touching contextTokens.
4. formatTokens boundaries: 9949 → '9.9k', 9950 → '10k', 999500 → '1.0M', 0 → '0'; contextTokens 0 hides the hint element.
5. With two tiled tabs holding contextTokens 3000 and 5000, the top-bar meter reads '~8.0k' and is hidden when not tiled.
